It pairs the 2.5 liter four cylinder with the Lineartronic CVT and Subaru all wheel drive, so Chicago winters are a non issue. Driver assistance is the real strength: EyeSight, adaptive cruise control, lane keep assist, blind spot detection, and a backup camera, backed by knee air bags and full length head curtain air bags. LED headlamps, fog lights, alloy wheels, and the All Weather Package round it out. Finished in silver over a black interior.
